### Devotional: Job 40
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-22-john-1-job-40-2-corinthians-10/
Passage: Job 40:1-5
Points:
- Throughout his suffering, Job maintained his basic loyalty to God and did not sin by cursing Him.
- Job erred, however, by feeling entitled to an explanation and coming close to accusing God of injustice.
- God’s challenge reminds Job that finite humans lack the knowledge or authority to contend with the Almighty.
- Job recognizes his own unworthiness and silences himself before God’s sovereign majesty.
- God continues pressing Job to lead him toward genuine humble repentance rather than mere cowed silence.
